description: Search in skill field
expectedResultReason: Candidates1,10–15 have skill field exactly 'Java,Spring,SQL'. Candidate8 does not, but is still a hit when the engine treats comma-separated keywords as OR (or similar): the token SQL matches the substring SQL in skill 'SQL Injection,XSS,...' and in longtextCF (booleanSearchCandidate_data.json). That is consistent with TC_BS_CAND_062, where Candidate8 is excluded because Java must match—showing SQL alone can satisfy part of a comma query but not a standalone Java conjunct. For an exact full skill value only, add a separate quoted-phrase case if your parser supports it.
